name: Paulista Teleport
blurb: Commercial satellite uplink that resells spare capacity.
banner: Satellite capacity by the hour. Prepaid sessions welcome.

content.text:
PAULISTA TELEPORT · TARIFFS 2034

Spare transponder capacity, by the hour:
  Ku band, shared          420 per hour
  Ku band, dedicated       1,150 per hour
  C band, dedicated        1,900 per hour

Minimum booking four hours. Capacity that is booked and not delivered is credited on the next bill, if the customer reports it within ten days.

Resellers: your contract rate applies, not this list.

Transponder 4 has been dropping packets between 02:00 and 03:00, three nights running. Cause: weather at the dish. Cause: not weather. Cause: unknown. Customers have not complained, which is the part that worries the NOC.

Customers more than ninety days in arrears lose service, unless they are a university, a hospital or a person who knows someone. The billing run on the twelfth is where arrears are calculated. If the run does not complete, nobody is cut off. That is not a policy. It is an observation.
